experiment_type: exploratory bundled intervention; ablation follows behavior inspection
objective: Test whether one coherent hybrid can keep coding-agent fluency while exploiting legal structure and deterministic compiler checks, improving long-horizon legal-task accuracy without uncontrolled context growth.

held_constant.judge: Codex Sol at below-normal process priority
held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB dev tasks only

comparison.reference: completed H4 operational/neutral run on the same task; frozen upstream Mike remains the external baseline

bundled_changes: Glob/Grep/Read/Edit remain the resident coding vocabulary; library_list is removed from coding mode and Glob emits durable IDs only for duplicate filenames.
Grep/Read retain exact legal section, page, table-row, and bounded direct-reference scopes plus immutable source-qualified working sets.
Progressive domains distinguish creation of a new Word deliverable, revision of an existing Word document, and audit of an existing DOCX.
Newly created or edited files rely on their compiler receipt instead of prompting the model to repeat optional quality tools.
Read truncation is machine-obvious and supplies an executable continuation recipe.

The existing SLA anchor, arithmetic, temporal, defined-term, and drafting organs run host-side over up to 32 source documents and the completed artifact, then expose only bounded typed findings for at most one correction pass.
The correction pass is a context checkpoint: original instructions, current deliverable, and bounded compiler findings remain; prior tool-result payloads are not replayed.
primary_observations: native LAB criterion score and valid deliverable
which deterministic findings the correction pass accepts, rejects, or mishandles
documents and exact source spans reached, including per-document exposure
tool sequence, failed calls, duplicate reads, and unnecessary domain openings
provider input/output/cache tokens, per-round tool argument/result bytes, tool-schema variants, and wall-clock latency
interpretation_policy: This bundled run may identify a promising product shape but cannot attribute causality. Do not call any component proven from this comparison. If the bundle improves the aggregate or reveals task-specific wins, ablate inventory/domain routing, working-set retrieval, and compiler/checkpoint behavior separately; if it loses, inspect traces before removing structure or deterministic checks wholesale.
failure_policy: Fail closed if Fast does not report priority, preserve operational failures in receipts, do not substitute tasks after seeing scores, and do not rerun a completed cell merely to hide an implementation failure.
